title: Prayer of St. Gertrude for the Holy Souls
text:
Eternal Father,
I offer Thee the Most Precious Blood
of Thy Divine Son, Jesus,
in union with the Masses said
throughout the world today,
for all the holy souls in Purgatory,
for sinners everywhere,
for sinners in the universal Church,
those in my own home
and within my family.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Æterne Pater,
offero Tibi Pretiosissimum Sanguinem
Divini Filii Tui, Jesu,
in unione cum Missis hodie
per totum mundum celebratis,
pro omnibus sanctis animabus in Purgatorio,
pro peccatoribus ubique terrarum,
pro peccatoribus in Ecclesia universali,
pro his qui sunt in domo mea
et in familia mea.
Amen.

notes: St. Gertrude the Great was a German Benedictine nun and mystic. According to tradition, Our Lord revealed to St. Gertrude that this prayer releases 1,000 souls from Purgatory each time it is said with devotion. While the Church has not officially confirmed this promise, the prayer remains a powerful intercession for the holy souls and has been treasured by the faithful for centuries. St. Gertrude is one of the few female saints given the title 'the Great.'
description: A powerful prayer by St. Gertrude the Great offering Christ's Precious Blood for the souls in Purgatory and sinners
